madeBy: studio art director (run 2026-09-30-offline-games), traced from the v2 raster frames - not an official ZeptoLab asset
units: px of the v2 frame canvas 525x506 (assets/characters/omnom/frames, unity/*.png), y down, x right; Om Nom faces the viewer-left
poseCanvas: action poses (unity/hang.png...) use a 640x608 canvas = these px + (64,0)
paletteNote: docs/style.md; two flat tones (body + shade), no gloss; outline = filled dark shape under the fill (variable width)
transform: bone local = T(t) * T(pivot) * R(r deg, + = clockwise on screen) * S(s) * T(-pivot); world = parent.world * local; shape points are rest-pose canvas px of the bone that owns them. Missing t/r/s = 0/0/1.
drawing: draw shapes by ascending z (zFront replaces z for parts listed in pose.front). clip = list of shape ids, intersect all (Canvas2D: clip() per path). Shapes of one merged group (z 200-310: outline pass then fill pass) overlap across joints - that is what hides the seams. hidden=true shapes are clip helpers or optional marks (eyes.joyL/R). z 500-599 = active mouth group (families.mouth). Paths: closed Catmull-Rom splines written as cubic Bezier (M ... C ... Z); in a family every slot has the same command list, so morphing = lerp of the numbers.

parts.note: root = feet contact point (pivot of every frame in omnom_frames.json); moves the whole character
flat contact shadow; keep on the ground (do not squash with the body)
squash & stretch around the feet (keep sx*sy ~ 1), lean; shapes = family body
back-left foot lobe (behind the body, own outline line)
pivot = mouth point; active mouth group drawn here (forms are relative to this point)
carries eyes, pupils, lids, sprout, hat anchor; pivot under the eyes
eye whites (one form, seam notch) + outline; family eyes
pupil of the far (viewer-left) eye; translate only, clamp to anchors.pupils
eyelids of the left eye (family lids)
upper arm, viewer-left; rest = folded inward behind the body (hidden)

body.morph: neutral <-> wide <-> wide2 (driven with the mouth open amount)

eyes.space: head-local px (= canvas px at rest)
eyes.morph: neutral <-> wide <-> wide2 (same driver as body)

lids.clipNote: each lid shape is clipped to eyes.white AND the half of its eye (eyes.halfL / eyes.halfR) - intersection of the listed clips
lids.morph: all members morph (open <-> half <-> blink, sad, chew, chew2); blink = open -> blink -> open, 130 ms (D-51)

mouth.space: px relative to the mouth point (anchors.mouth); draw at mouth.world * translate(origin)
mouth.rule: morph only inside a group (equal point counts); switch groups in one frame at the peak of a squash (D-51). Teeth: 4 upper (2 corner fangs + 2 inner, blunt round tips), 2 lower in wide mouths - v2 rule.

mouth.note: = omnom_frames.json anchorsLogical.mouth (centre of the wide mouth, level point om)

hat.note: centre of the hat cuff bottom (omnom_frames.json head.frames.neutral) in head-local px; the hat is a child of head

pupils.rule: pupil centre p = rest + gaze offset (head-local); clamp p into travel[eyesForm][eye] ellipse: q=(p-c)/radii, |q|>1 -> p=c+q/|q|*radii. Checked: 8 directions at the ellipse edge -> 0 px of a pupil outside its own eye (eyes.white x half). Same ellipses as omnom_frames.json pupils.*.eyes.*.travel (ajar uses the neutral form under its head transform).

l.note: wrist; attach a rope/candy grip here

r.note: wrist; attach a rope/candy grip here

posesNote: static check poses (bone offsets + forms) that reproduce the v2 frames and D-27 poses; iou = silhouette IoU with the v2 frame. Not animation clips.
